title: An agent detached from a room and attached to it again keeps nothing it stored there: a re-read of the earlier result finds nothing stored
notes: Python: red before RMK-1645 (the re-read read the earlier result back), green after. The other states a room's detach lets go of are proven in Python: tests/test_mcp_skills_execution_gate.py test_an_approval_lets_it_run_and_holds_for_the_fingerprint and tests/test_mcp_skills_realtime_door.py test_an_approval_does_not_outlive_the_room_s_binding (approvals to run a served skill's code), tests/test_executor_without_store.py test_a_hook_outside_any_turn_reads_the_executor_s_last_turn_in_the_room (an executor's last context of the room). A room the channel joins starts from nothing an earlier room of the same id left (§6.4), and the results it evicted are per-room state it discards as it lets the room go (§10.6.2): a room created again for another person under the same id read the earlier person's stored result.
